[package]
name = "kvhttp"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2024"
description = "In-memory HTTP/1.1 key-value server"
publish = false

[[bin]]
name = "app"
path = "src/main.rs"

[dependencies]
libc = "0.2"

[profile.release]
opt-level = 3
lto = true
codegen-units = 1
panic = "unwind"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Builds an optimised release binary at ./app.
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")"

cargo build --release --locked
cp target/release/app ./app
